content.short: AIShi runs a family of World App mini apps where users play games and earn AIShi coins.
content.description: AIShi builds several mini apps inside World App, including AIShi Games, where players compete in casual games and earn AIShi coins, as well as a coin claim app, radio and chat apps. Its games site says it is built on World Chain, and the apps are listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: AIShi runs play-to-earn game mini apps in World App, built on World Chain.
content.pageTitle: AIShi - Decentralized Games - Lancers Web3 Explorer
